inline_evidence_budget.cadence: On-demand authorized submit/provide_input; existing Persona cadence only. No new job, table, queue or collection.
inline_evidence_budget.successful_write_count: One existing-ticket CAS and at most one existing-KW-02 note insert, committed together. Failed/denied/stale commands and exact retries: zero writes/events.
inline_evidence_budget.size_count: Existing command/note <=16384 encoded bytes; <=128 notes per ticket; <=256 history entries and <=262144 encoded ticket bytes. Inline note plus <=7 ordinary refs.
inline_evidence_budget.hosted_growth_per_day: Same <=72 scheduled-origin tickets/week; one inline note each <=10.29 notes/day (<=168521.15 encoded note bytes/day at max16KiB). No growth beyond already-budgeted lifetime <=128 notes/ticket (~20.58MiB/day maximum lifetime note payload allocated to new scheduled origins). Unscheduled human-convened meetings counted separately.
inline_evidence_budget.reads: Lists do not resolve bodies. Authorized detail resolves <=16 distinct note primary keys (current submission plus human_input), <=256KiB note records in addition to original <=256KiB ticket. Direct human-actionable descriptions come from the same SQL page, <=100 rows and no extra per-ticket requests. Probe adds <=16 note GETs on demand.
inline_evidence_budget.cleanup: No temporary/orphan note after partial inline failure: transaction rollback removes both writes. Successful immutable notes retain original preservation policy; full-table retention remains unbounded RC3 WP3.1. No deleting historical or open obligations.

required_data_budget.size_count: 0..8 distinct dataset identifiers, raw <=256 characters each, trimmed nonempty; normalized array <=4096 encoded JSON bytes. Field plus JSON key <=4115 bytes per ticket within existing 16KiB assignment and 256KiB ticket caps. Not copied into lifecycle history.

Evidence-only/old tickets omit the field with zero incremental bytes.
